cli.finalMessage:
Built the two-factor authentication section in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` (default export) with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- Toggle switch turns 2FA on/off; turning it off opens a confirmation dialog (role="alertdialog", closable via Cancel/Escape/backdrop) warning that it lowers account security before disabling.
- When on, radio options let the user pick "Authenticator app" or "Text message" (with a mock masked phone number).
- A "Show/Hide codes" control reveals mock backup codes, with one marked as already used.
- Styling uses Strata design tokens (`--strata-color-*`, `--strata-space-*`, `--strata-radius-*`, `--strata-font-body`) with sensible fallbacks, and logical CSS properties/RTL-aware switch transform so it should adapt across the brand/light-dark/RTL/density variations mentioned in the README.

Note: no `node_modules` were present for `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` in this sandbox, so I built the UI with semantic HTML and CSS Modules against the token variables rather than guessing at unverified component APIs.
